title: hassan askari ko ye dilbar mubarak
body:
hassan askari ko ye dilbar mubarak
ye dilbar mubarak ye safdar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
imame zama'n apna paida hua hai
ye hai ba hawa'n sab ka rehbar mubaarak
<<DIVIDER>>
hawae'n bhi jannat ki lehra rahi hai
ke qushbu se ghar hai moattar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aawaaze salwat har ghar se aati
tawallud ke hai naare ghar ghar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
hai qatm imaamat imaame zama'n par
ye aaqir hamaara hai rehbar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hai maahe shabano maahe moazzam
qushi momino ko hai ghar ghar mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
nabuwat hai haafiz imamat ka maalik
tumhe ye qalifa payambar mubarak
